summary: st usage and every usage panel list the declared accounts, each row and limit read against the account that declares it; an account can claim provider labels, be an api-key account with a monthly credit budget, and Codex and the default Claude login are attributed at launch

replay.detail: No claim kind or replay change. Attribution is applied when usage and limits are read, so existing history is read against the declared account.

schema.detail: No database schema change. The client contract adds optional fields: UsagePeriod.accounts, UsageRow.account_ref, and the UsageAccount and UsageCredits types.

compatibility.detail: Behavior change: an unbound seat now runs on the declared account whose login is its harness's default (~/.claude, ~/.codex), and an omp seat on the api-key account that names it, so those seats receive ST3_ACCOUNT when they next launch and the account's limits govern them. A new account declaration may carry identity, harness, monthly-credits-usd; an older daemon refuses a declaration that uses them, so apply such a declaration after this build is running on every host. Older clients ignore the new fields.

manual.detail: Declare the accounts a fleet wants listed, including api-key accounts, after upgrading every host.

recovery.detail: No recovery change; an older build reports the same rows under the provider's own labels again.
